description: This file defines an interface TaskQueueInterface within the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, specifying methods for managing a task queue such as checking if the queue is empty, adding tasks, and running tasks.

classes.name: TaskQueueInterface
classes.description: Interface defining methods for a task queue in a promise implementation.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the task queue is empty.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a callable task to the queue.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes all pending tasks in the queue.
